Guidance & outlook: During Q1 FY27, our stand-alone operational revenue grew by 5.8% year-on-year to INR4,081 million, with consolidated revenue reaching INR4,662 million, up by 8.2% year-on-year.
Our domestic formulations business recorded revenues of INR2,040 million in quarter 1 FY27.

International formulations contributed 35% of the quarter 1 FY27 revenue at INR1,451 million, while our active pharmaceuticals business delivered a stellar performance this quarter, surging to 42% Y -o-Y and a turnover of INR522 million.
Growth & demand: Cyclopam continues its trajectory as a major growth champion, achieving 44% absolute growth since 2022 to now reach INR196 crores on the verge of becoming a landmark INR200 crores mega brand.
Our focused portfolio, including SM Fibro, Rexidin - M, Oxipod CV and Dropizin recorded an aggregate growth of 86%, with Dropizin delivering a 3x breakout to reach INR14 crores.
Stand - alone net revenues of the company for the first quarter of FY26-'27 grew by 5.8% at INR4,081 million compared to INR3,856 million for the same quarter last year.
Margins & costs: Stand- alone EBITDA saw expansion to INR422 million, delivering an EBITDA margin of 10.3%.
Through an emphasis on building and scaling high-margin brands as per IQVIA MAT June '26, our top 5 flagship brands now contribute 42% to our total domestic portfolio.

Stand-alone EBITDA to net sales for the quarter is 10.3% at INR422 million compared to 3.8% at INR148 million for the same quarter last year and for the immediate preceding quarter is 14.7% at INR630 million.
Capex & expansion: So, I think Goa plant I right now on a single shift basis is occupied to 80% roughly.
And Baddi I, which is a smaller capacity, high -value kind of plant i s also occupied to the range of 70% to 80% on a single shift that too.
Baddi III, which is the large plant which makes paracetamol, again, in the range of 70%, 75%, if I'm not mistaken.
Balance sheet & cash: So overall debt, we have reduced by almost about INR30-odd crores as compared to what we used to have in March '26.
So, overall debt level remains at around INR930 crores now as against INR964 crores as of March '26.
Our debt level, long -term debt is at currently INR600 crores.

Of course, there were challenges of product availability because of war issues.
